Keep searchers outside the frame, represented only by their flashlight beams. Preserve the surrounding terrain and the restrained documentary atmosphere. Late May vegetation, no snow or ice. No bear, additional people, invented props, text, subtitles, or graphics. This is the opening image for a continuous video shot: the body must already be present and visible, with no subsequent appearance of a new subject or change of composition.
